text: We fixed the API outage today, so everything's working again and you can keep using the API as usual. Sorry for the trouble, and thanks for your patience. Live status: https://status.apmix.ai/

Payment update for apmix.ai We're removing fungies.io from the site. Stripe has placed restrictions on Fungies' account, and from December 1 they won't be able to process payments or renewals anymore. So from now on all subscriptions go through creem.io only. If you subscribed through Fungies, your subscription will be cancelled and won't renew. To keep your plan, subscribe again from apmix.ai/dashboard/billing . Your account and API keys stay the same. We're also sending an email to everyone affected. Questions: support@apmix.ai
